title: Novel inhibitor of OCT1 enhances the sensitivity of human esophageal squamous cell carcinoma cells to antitumor agents.
authors: Zou, Xiao-Zheng; Zhou, Xiu-Hua; Feng, Ying-Qi; Hao, Jun-Feng; Liang, Bing; Jia, Meng-Wei
one_liner_zh: 该文通过分子对接发现OCT1小分子抑制剂并验证其增强食管鳞癌化疗敏感性，涉及TF-DNA结合抑制，但核心是药物筛选与细胞实验，互作机制和AI/物理模拟深度有限。
abstract: Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (ESCC) is one of the most fatal malignancies of the digestive system, and shows an especially high incidence in some regions of China. Octamer transcription factors are a family of transcription factors whose DNA-binding domain is a POU domain. OCT transcription factors (OCT-TFs) mediate maintenance of the pluripotency of embryonic stem cells. We measured expression of OCT-TFs in ESCC clinical specimens. Among the OCTs tested, OCT1 showed the highest expression in ESCC tissues. Using molecular docking, we discovered a small-molecule inhibitor, which we named "novel inhibitor of OCT1" (NIO-1), for OCT1. Treatment with NIO-1 inhibited recruitment of OCT1 to the promoter region of its downstream genes and, consequently, repressed OCT1 activation. Treatment with NIO-1 enhanced the susceptibility of ESCC cells to chemotherapeutic agents. Therefore, OCT1 may be a valuable target for ESCC treatment, and NIO-1 could be a promising therapeutic agent.
abstract_zh: 食管鳞状细胞癌（ESCC）是消化系统中最致命的恶性肿瘤之一，在中国某些地区发病率尤其高。八聚体转录因子是一类其DNA结合域为POU结构域的转录因子家族。OCT转录因子（OCT-TFs）介导胚胎干细胞多能性的维持。我们在ESCC临床标本中测量了OCT-TFs的表达。在检测的OCTs中，OCT1在ESCC组织中表现出最高表达。通过分子对接，我们发现了一种小分子抑制剂，将其命名为“OCT1新型抑制剂”（NIO-1），针对OCT1。NIO-1处理抑制了OCT1向其下游基因启动子区域的招募，从而抑制了OCT1的激活。NIO-1处理增强了ESCC细胞对化疗药物的敏感性。因此，OCT1可能是ESCC治疗的一个有价值靶点，而NIO-1可能是一种有前景的治疗药物。
